table: M48 Tier A — seed band, selection criterion, feature-extractor null
baseline: M45 A0 (M22_v2) = 0.5602 on the corrected official 60/40 split

seed_band.reading: Any M45 delta smaller than this spread is not distinguishable from run-to-run noise, whatever its sign.

A24_feature_extractor_null.reading: A4 froze a PRETRAINED backbone, so its -0.1007 mixes the value of fine-tuning with the value of pretraining. This row freezes a RANDOM one and separates them.

cumulative_ladder_note: S3-S5 are reused from M45 (A3, M22_v2, P3). Run cumulative_table.py to assemble both orderings.
selection_caveat: m45_ablation.py monitors the TEST set each epoch; there is no separate validation split. 'select on loss' therefore means test loss. Optimistic, and equally so for every row, so the seed band and the A2+A4 delta are unaffected — but A7 must be reported as two criteria on one monitoring set, never as a clean train/val/test result.
